title: Normalized open completed restriction comparison data
statement: Fix a prime and finite coefficient extension [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], an open immersion j:U→X [def-weil-open-immersion], and the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For their completed integral coefficient rings [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], define ordinary module-sheaf restriction r [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] by precomposition along V/U↦V/X and inverse scalar  transport through the unique constant-section- and quotient-projection-preserving coefficient isomorphisms; define D(r) by exact termwise localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Define Comparison to be assertion data for the strict quotient-tower comparison with integral pullback [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], finite inverse images [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and coefficient restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Its level comparisons on flat-term K-flat representatives [def-pc-kflat-complex] preserve graph-coprojection sections, its product comparison preserves every projection, its Roos comparison preserves both cone coordinates, and its derived comparison is normalized by localization of those same maps. Define κ:D(r)→Lj* as the restriction of the canonical completion unit followed by that derived comparison. This defines data and maps; it asserts neither existence of Comparison nor invertibility of κ.
